content:
{
  "root_cause": "The Escape key in a submenu was closing all open submenus of the root menu instead of just the current submenu, causing focus to incorrectly return to the menubar item with its aria-expanded set to false.",
  "repair_strategy": "Replace the Escape key handler in submenus to close only the toggle of the parent menu's current menu item (which opened the current submenu) and then focus the parent menu's current menu item, ensuring only the current submenu closes and focus returns to the correct parent menu item.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "src/menubar.js",
      "sha256": "35aa52673b33aeb4479c15d3f7863ce741e0ce9eee109ee5c70ae02a87a30864",
      "before": "        } else if (key === \"Escape\") {\n          // Hitting Escape:\n          // - Closes submenu.\n          // - Moves focus to parent menubar item.\n          preventEvent(event);\n          this.elements.rootMenu.closeChildren();\n          this.elements.rootMenu.focusCurrentChild();\n        }\n",
      "after": "        } else if (key === \"Escape\") {\n          // Hitting Escape:\n          // - Closes submenu.\n          // - Moves focus to parent menubar item.\n          preventEvent(event);\n          const parentMenu = this.elements.parentMenu;\n          if (parentMenu) {\n            const currentMenuItem = parentMenu.elements.menuItems[parentMenu.currentChild];\n            if (currentMenuItem && currentMenuItem.isSubmenuItem) {\n              currentMenuItem.elements.toggle.close();\n            }\n          }\n          if (parentMenu) {\n            parentMenu.focusCurrentChild();\n          }\n        }\n"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Escape in the Facts submenu will close only the Facts submenu (setting its aria-expanded to false) and return focus to the Facts item, while the About submenu remains open (its aria-expanded stays true).",
  "functional_risks": [
    "If the parent menu's currentChild is incorrect due to unrelated bugs, focus may shift to an unintended menu item.",
    "If the parent menu's current menu item is not a submenu item (should not occur when entering a submenu from it), the toggle close is skipped but focus still shifts to the parent menu's current menu item, which is safe but may not be the expected item.",
    "For deeply nested submenus, this change correctly closes only the immediate submenu and returns focus to its parent menu item, preserving the menubar pattern."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Verify that pressing Escape in the Facts submenu (with About submenu open) results in focus on the Facts item (#facts), the Facts submenu's aria-expanded is false, and the About submenu's aria-expanded remains true.",
    "Verify that pressing Escape in the top-level menubar (with no submenu open) still closes the controller if open and focuses the controller.",
    "Verify that pressing Escape in a submenu when the parent menu's current menu item is not a submenu item (if possible) does not cause errors and focuses the parent menu's current menu item.",
    "Verify that pressing Escape in a deeply nested submenu (e.g., three levels) closes only the immediate submenu and returns focus to its parent menu item."
  ]
}
